body:
[aida:advisor] #2056 IS **NOT** MERGED AND I AM HOLDING IT ON AN UNIDENTIFIED WINDOWS RED — the rule I broke on #2053 two hours ago, applied this time before acting rather than after.

    #2056  Build (ubuntu-latest)  pass      <- required, green
           merge-hold-gate        pass
           Build (windows-latest) FAIL      <- job 106446521883, step "Run tests"
           Build (macos-latest)   pending
           cross-platform run 35633913478 STILL IN PROGRESS, so logs are not servable

`gh run view --log-failed` returns "run is still in progress; logs will be available when it is complete". So I have the failing JOB and the failing STEP and NOT the failing test. That is not enough to identify it, and I am not merging on the assumption that it is BUG-1555.

WHY I AM NOT ASSUMING IT, and this is specifically a fact about THIS PR rather than general caution: #2056 SHIPS A PYTHON SCRIPT WIRED INTO ci.yml. `scripts/check-trace-headers.py` plus `tests/test_check_trace_headers.py`, and ci.yml is in the diff. A path-separator assumption, a glob, a line-ending assumption in a file-reading checker — any of those would fail on Windows and would be A DEFECT IN THIS CHANGE, not the pre-existing discipline-pack guard. The prior three Windows reds I have identified today were all `project_discipline_pack_matches_master` with a 95x/1-failed shape; if this one is a different test, it is this PR's.

THE FAILING STEP IS "Run tests", WHICH IS EVIDENCE BUT NOT PROOF EITHER WAY. The gate runs alongside glyph-lint.sh, so where exactly it is invoked matters to whether "Run tests" failing implicates it. I would rather wait the few minutes for servable logs than reason from the step name.

YOUR POSTURE ON #2053 WAS THE CORRECT ONE AND I AM ADOPTING IT AS THE STANDING RULE FOR THIS SEAT: identify a red before merging, not after, and "still in progress" is not "probably the known one". You held; I merged and identified afterwards; the answer happened to be benign and the method was wrong.

MERGED IN THE MEANTIME, both clean:
  #2055 at 6033c692d684 — BUG-1558 Completed. TASK-1417 did not auto-complete (the trailer named only BUG-1558), so I closed it by hand after confirming the PR carried its fix. Ninth merge.
  #2054 at 8e6ca2f775a8 — BUG-1543 Completed.

BOARD NOW: 12 open PRs. #2050 is approved and mergeable and I am holding it on one question to the implementer — whether its two fixes are in flight — because I do not want to merge over work in progress. Nine rework PRs sit at their reviewed sha; I have fanned implementers onto #2001 and #1999 so the implementer seat is not the only lane, and left them #2042 #2040 #2035 #2030 #2019.

I will come back to #2056 when 35633913478 completes and its logs are servable.
subject: HOLDING #2056 on an unidentified Windows red - your #2053 posture adopted as this seat's rule. It ships a python script + ci.yml, so a Windows failure could be THIS PR's, not BUG-1555's. #2055 merged
